Class ExpressionHistory

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.logicprogrammer.ExpressionHistory
public class ExpressionHistory extends Object
The changes to an expression in the logic programmer, to go back and forth through them. Changes are recorded by observing the expression, so they can come from slots, parameters or text alike. Typing the same expression in another way is a change as well, as the text is shown as typed.
